create_better_networking.configuration.s: Ku muuji aqoonsiga shabakadda muuqaalka iftiiminta sabuuradda marka shabakadu aanay magac lahayn
create_better_networking.frequency.contr: Shift + guji bidix si aad u koobiyeyso; guji bidix si aad u dhejiso. Si aad shabakadda magac ugu bixiso, sabuuradda ku dar qoraal ka kooban keliya #network: Link Series.
create_better_networking.frequency.empty: Soo noqnoqosho lama kaydin. Shift + guji bidix baloog ku xiran si aad u koobiyeyso.
create_better_networking.frequency.prote: Fasax uma lihid inaad beddesho shabakaddan
create_better_networking.frequency.same: Balooggan ayaa hore u isticmaalaya soo noqnoqoshadan
